'''R4-L9'''<ref name="CWA" /> was an [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4 astromech droid]]<ref name="R4 Note" /> equipped with hazardous weather gear.<ref name="CWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|R4-L9 is outfitted with the latest hazardous weather gear, making him the ideal companion for the most toxic of worlds!|In-game store description for R4-L9|<ref name="CWA" />}}
R4-L9 appeared in the [[2010]] massively multiplayer [[Star Wars video games|online game]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] as a companion players could purchase for 4499 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic Credits]].<ref name="CWA" />
